spans.s: The 11th consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, and first of the 3rd class or cerebrals. It corresponds in sound to the letter T pronounced far back in the mouth, or as in true, and is expressed in the roman character by the accented letter T.

m. (-टः)
1 Sound, or a particular sound, like the twang of a bow strong.
2 A dwarf.
3 A quarter, a fourth.
n. (-टं)
A hollowed cocoanut.
f. (टा)
1 The earth.
2 An oath, confirming an assertion by ordeal, &c.
E.
टक to bind, &c. affix ड.
